eye: horizontal eye diameter (ED); side not stated
method: linear measurement of the type series with a Vernier caliper; Materials and methods > Morphological measurements prints measurements 'to the nearest 0.1 mm' and defines 'ED (horizontal eye diameter)'
conditions: Male of Blommersia nataliae sp. nov. Measured specimen: paratype DRV6863 (male; field number DRV6863), Sex cell 'M'. Type material as printed (reader's pieces): Holotype 'An adult male' with field number DRV6867, MNCN50456; Paratypes 'Females DRV6808 (MNCN50451), DRV6854 (MNCN50447), DRV6855 (MNCN50448), DRV6868 (MNCN50450), DRV6869 (MNCN50449); males DRV6857 (MNCN50453), DRV6859 (MNCN50455), DRV6860 (MNCN50458), DRV6861 (MNCN50454), DRV6862 (MNCN50452), DRV6863 (MNCN50457)' (11 paratypes, all in the Table 1 rows below). Locality cell 'Mont M'Sapere' (Mayotte, Comoros archipelago). Table 1 caption: 'Measurements of Blommersia nataliae sp. nov. and B. transmarina for comparison. The holotype of B. nataliae sp. nov. is shown in bold letters.' (caption shortened by the reader to its opening and closing words; the table also holds B. transmarina rows, which are not filed). Table 1 header row as returned by the reader: Species, Locality, Field number, MNCN catalog, Sex, SVL, HW, HL, TD, ED, END, NSD, NND, FORL, HAL, HIL, FOTL, FOL, TIBL, FGL, FGW, FGD, RHL (the reader reports the printed header as 'MNCN (Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales) catalog'). The quote is the whole row as delivered in the Pensoft CSV download of Table 1, cells joined by single spaces, with the empty cells (FGL, FGW, FGD where blank; the Species cell is merged and not repeated on this row) left out; the 18 value cells after Sex run SVL, HW, HL, TD, ED, END, NSD, NND, FORL, HAL, HIL, FOTL, FOL, TIBL, FGL, FGW, FGD, RHL. Cross-checks: the Sex cells of all 11 B. nataliae paratype rows agree with the sexes in the printed type list (5 females, 6 males, field numbers and MNCN numbers matching), and the Variation text prints male SVL 17.9-20.5 mm and female SVL 19.6-23 mm, equal to the minimum and maximum SVL cells of the male and female rows. Holotype DRV6867 is NOT filed: the Description of the holotype prints 'tympanum distinct and rounded, with a diameter of 60% of the eye diameter' while its Table 1 cells (TD 1.5, ED 2.8) give 54%. Units: the Table 1 caption prints no unit; Materials and methods > Morphological measurements prints measurements 'to the nearest 0.1 mm' with a Vernier caliper and the text prints SVL in mm. Measured side not stated.
